first_page: Music page /music/ for listeners who want to find and play songs without an account. First: search songs/artists (iTunes Search, keyless), play the 30 s preview or the full official video embed, a queue with shuffle/repeat, playlists kept on the device and shared as a link, and "make me a song" beside it. Will not build: full-track licensed streaming, downloads, Connect, social feeds or AI DJ.
